aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: TV star Samar faces a nightmare when his ex-girlfriend falsely accuses him of rape after he cuts ties with her, plunging him into a corrupt legal battle.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Samar's life as a popular TV star unravels when his ex-girlfriend Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks all contact. Despite moving on and building a new relationship with Khushi, Samar is abruptly arrested and thrown into police custody. As he tries to clear his name, he must navigate a prejudiced justice system and hostile public perception to prove his innocence.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Samar is a celebrated television actor whose life seems on the right track as he begins a promising new relationship with Khushi. However, his past returns to haunt him when his ex-partner Gayatri struggles to accept the end of their relationship. After Samar blocks her communication, a bitter Gayatri files a formal police complaint accusing him of rape. The sudden allegations trigger a swift arrest, turning Samar's glitzy world upside down overnight. Locked inside a harrowing jail system, he encounters corrupt law enforcement officers and prejudiced legal hurdles. While Khushi and his legal team scramble to uncover evidence, Samar faces intense media trial and betrayal from industry peers. The trial exposes deep-seated flaws in the justice system, forcing Samar to fight relentlessly for his dignity and freedom against calculated malice.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Bandar is a tense dramatic thriller that explores the dark intersection of celebrity culture, personal vengeance, and legal vulnerability. The narrative follows Samar, a rising television actor whose life is derailed when a former partner, unable to cope with their breakup, levies severe criminal charges against him. As Samar is forced to endure a ruthless justice system and a court of public opinion, the story delves into themes of truth, power dynamics, and the psychological toll of fighting a biased system.
